comment: Goal 3 sets no coordination measure. We recommend adding follow-up / referral completion as a Goal-3 indicator — the most actionable coordination measure. In one real network, only ~7% of referrals were completed (4,707 of 67,478). Completion is an operational, leading measure, not the end in itself: where feasible it should be linked to downstream service delivery and outcomes — whether the person received the appropriate service in time, and whether continuity of care improved. A shared capability makes this visible and improvable.
